The public blog retains its original CSS dependencies, without their JavaScript plugins:
- Bootstrap 4.6.2 CSS: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@4.6.2/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css (MIT).
- Font Awesome 4.7.0 CSS and WOFF2: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/font-awesome@4.7.0/ (CSS MIT; font SIL OFL 1.1).
- Rubik regular/italic 400, 500, 700: Google Fonts, Rubik v31. See ../fonts/Rubik-OFL.txt.
- Original Affiliates theme and its attribution remain in docs/assets/css/theme.css.
Font URLs are local. Keep the original license comments when updating these assets.
The administrator file manager has its own Bootstrap 5 CSS bundle.
